name: InTac G1
summary: An integrated tactile gripper that combines optical tactile fingertips with closed-loop position, force and impedance control for precise and compliant robot manipulation.

description.en: An integrated tactile gripper that combines optical tactile fingertips with closed-loop position, force and impedance control for precise and compliant robot manipulation.
